name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_destructor
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::Destructor resets event-sink lifetime state and deletes its critical section.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja renders VC EH/null-guard scaffolding around DeleteCriticalSection as an sbb.d expression, and no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x441680 validates the thiscall destructor contract, event-sink vtable reset, refcount reset to 1, InterlockedDecrement(&g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiInitState.eventSinkLiveCount), DeleteCriticalSection(&m_refCountAndLock.lock), and void return.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_lifetime_smoke initializes an event sink, calls Destructor directly, and verifies vtable reset, refcount reset, live-count decrement, and no critical-section cleanup crash.
